why: The GJCE guidelines specify the goals, content, requirements, and pedagogical activities of one higher-education course implementation rather than proposing a general explanatory theory of learning.
G-Jump is a setting-specific anesthesia assessment sequence that combines a Triple Jump Exercise with gamification, rather than a general instructional element or an established adoptable product.

G-Jump is a study-specific gamified assessment design for undergraduate anesthesia students that combines existing Self-Determination, Flow, and formative-feedback ideas rather than proposing a general learning theory.
